name: GAN 356 ME 3x3 (Magnetic) - Charmander, Pokémon Series
description: The GAN 356 ME 3x3 (Magnetic) - Charmander, Pokémon Series brings the GAN 356 ME magnetic speed cube together with the official Pokémon lineup, decked out in Charmander's fiery orange with a custom center cap, themed magnet chambers, and a six-color palette built to pop on every turn.
features: Six-color vibrance: Custom six-color plastic tiles paired with matching inner shells keep the faces bright and easy to read during fast solves.
Collector-ready: Officially licensed Pokémon artwork makes this one worth displaying as much as solving.
Magnetic feel: Magnets pull each layer into alignment for faster, more accurate turning that clicks into place.
Themed magnet chambers: Green magnet chambers tie into the color story while keeping the positioning consistent.
Custom center cap: The Charmander center block anchors the theme and gives the cube its own identity on the shelf.
